interpretation: Eligibility means a valid worker input, not a guarantee of a valid generated forecast.
All 2000 active universe tickers are included; no trade, holdout, MRCY, or CSQR exclusions are applied.
Snapshot target dates follow features/main.py:31-33: strictly later than 2025-11-11 through 2026-11-11 inclusive (251 XNYS dates).

Historical grid includes every active ticker for every eligible XNYS target, independent of target-day actuals; the separately reported count with stored target bars identifies available feature-row joins.
All-allowed historical grid starts at manifest first_allowed_target 2024-07-01; absent pre-cache histories are classified short_history. Actual eligible range is reported separately.

Primary unavailable reasons are mutually exclusive in this priority: missing_file, invalid_structure, short_history (required sessions precede first stored session), gaps_or_stale_history (internal or trailing absent sessions), invalid_data.
Non-XNYS source rows are not used; input values are exact stored OHLCV converted to float, with no repair, interpolation, adjustment, or use of Adj Close.
Daily context is 2026-05-12 through 2026-11-11, 128 completed sessions. Context must pass the worker close-plus-15-minute buffer.

Time estimates multiply eligible requests by measured MPS 0.02312 seconds/request. They exclude worker load, request construction, serialization, cache/storage and other pipeline overhead; they are not measured backfill runtimes.
Historical reconstructions use current stored price histories. Input eligibility does not establish historical first-observed availability or eliminate revision/survivorship bias.

independent_rolling_count_check.method: Re-read and re-hash all source files, independently compare shifted pandas rolling(128) valid-row counts against initial cumulative-sum coverage for each ticker.

CSQR.explanation: The local PriceStore has 84 consecutive XNYS rows from 2026-07-16 through 2026-11-11. The 2026-11-12 target requires 128 rows from 2026-05-12 through 2026-11-11; 44 leading sessions from 2026-05-12 through 2026-07-15 are absent. No company-history explanation is inferred.

method.row_validity: All 5 numeric inputs finite and <=float32 max; all OHLC >0; volume>=0; high>=max(open,low,close); low<=min(open,close); finite OHLC4*volume<=float32 max.
method.rolling_eligibility: At target position p, the 128 sessions [p-128,p) must all be present and valid. Count by cumulative sums, independently checked by rolling(128). No target-day value enters its own eligibility.
method.completed_session_check: All audited context ends are <=2026-11-11, whose XNYS close+15 minutes precedes this audit. Actual worker guards verified on 203 samples with inference sentinel.
method.read_only_actions: Read universe/price files and runtime validation code only; wrote audit JSON and companion Markdown only; no downloads, model loading, predictions, training, feature writes, commits, or data repairs.

latest_bar_provenance.conclusion: The Nov11 invalid rows were persisted by the after-close Yahoo daily refresh. Read-only previous-snapshot comparison directly observes latest-day bar revisions on the next refresh. App row merge does not splice individual OHLC fields; no morning-open write-back or app adjustment operation explains these rows. No raw Yahoo response or per-row provider metadata is stored, so upstream raw-data versus yfinance construction cannot be separated by this audit.
